short_description: Order entry screens hang on save, ORA-00054 resource busy
description: Multiple order entry users report the save button spinning then ORA-00054 resource busy and acquire with NOWAIT. AWR shows enq: TX - row lock contention on ORDERS.
resolution_notes: Blocking session query on v$session showed SID 812 from an idle order entry app session (INACTIVE 40 min) holding a row lock on ORDERS. Killed the session with ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION after L2 approval per ORA-RB-001. Waits cleared, users able to save.

short_description: Billing batch blocking online orders, users cannot update order lines
description: Between 23:30 and 00:15 users could not update ORDER_LINES; sessions waiting on row lock contention. Blocker was BILL_NIGHTLY.
resolution_notes: Identified blocker as BILL_NIGHTLY via v$session program/module. Did not kill the batch. Asked batch team to pause online order import until batch finished at 00:20. Contention cleared once batch committed.

short_description: Deadlock style waits on ORDERS table, order saves timing out
description: Order save timing out for call centre agents, database shows sessions blocked on ORDERS, error resource busy.
resolution_notes: Ran the blocking session query from ORA-RB-001; blocker was an INACTIVE session from app server ordapp03 idle 25 minutes. Killed session with L2 approval. Raised problem ticket with Java team for missing commit in order update code.

short_description: Apps cannot connect to ORDPRD, ORA-12519 no appropriate service handler
description: order-api and reporting cannot open new connections, ORA-12519 TNS no appropriate service handler found. Listener log shows ORDAPP blocked.
resolution_notes: v$resource_limit showed processes at limit. Session count per machine showed ordapp02 holding 900 sessions (connection leak). App team restarted ordapp02 under emergency change. Processes utilisation fell to 45%, connections recovered.

short_description: Intermittent ORA-12520 from reporting server
description: Reporting jobs failing intermittently with ORA-12520 listener could not find available handler.
resolution_notes: Found reporting server rpt01 leaking sessions. Killed inactive sessions older than 60 minutes from rpt01 (L2). Reporting team restarted the reporting service in approved window.

short_description: Login failed for new ETL user ORA-01017
description: New ETL service account cannot log in, ORA-01017 invalid username/password.
resolution_notes: Password had been set with wrong case. Access team reset through vault request. Not a platform issue.

short_description: RMAN nightly backup failed ORA-19504 on ORDPRD
description: Nightly RMAN full backup failed at 01:12 with ORA-19504 failed to create file and ORA-27040 file create error.
resolution_notes: Runbook ORA-RB-003 is outdated (bkp01 and /backup_old were decommissioned). Actual cause: NFS share nas02:/backup/ordprd not mounted on ordprd2 after patching. Remounted with mount /backup/ordprd on ordprd2 (L2, standard change), re-ran RMAN backup from ordprd1. Completed OK.

short_description: Backup job ORDPRD FAILED status, file create error
description: RMAN backup report shows FAILED with ORA-27040 file create error, unable to create file on /backup/ordprd.
resolution_notes: Old runbook steps for bkp01 no longer valid. /backup/ordprd NFS mount from nas02 missing on node 2. Remounted the share and re-ran backup. Suggest updating ORA-RB-003.

short_description: RMAN backup failure ORA-19502 write error
description: RMAN backup failed with ORA-19502 write error on file, backup piece incomplete.
resolution_notes: nas02 share had filled to 100%. Ran DELETE NOPROMPT OBSOLETE in RMAN to clear backups outside the 7 day window, confirmed free space, re-ran backup from ordprd1. ORA-RB-003 paths are outdated.

short_description: Order search very slow after monthly bulk load
description: Order search takes 40+ seconds after the month-end bulk load; plan changed to full table scan on ORDERS.
resolution_notes: dba_tab_statistics showed stale stats on ORDERS and ORDER_LINES. Gathered stats with DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS cascade at 20:00 off peak. Search back to 2 seconds.

short_description: Slow order report queries, full scans after data load
description: Order reports slow since yesterday's load, execution plan regression.
resolution_notes: Stale optimizer statistics after bulk load. Gathered table statistics for ORD schema tables flagged stale. Plan reverted to index range scan.

short_description: Schema migration script failed ORA-00955 name already used
description: Release migration failed with ORA-00955 name is already used by an existing object on index ORD_IDX7.
resolution_notes: Release team re-ran migration with the idempotent version of the script that checks for existing index. Completed.

short_description: PAYR010 abended S0C7 in STEP03
description: Payroll job PAYR010 ended NOTOK in Control-M with abend S0C7 at STEP03. Downstream payroll jobs held.
resolution_notes: CEEDUMP pointed to packed field EMP-AMT. HR input file PRD.HR.PAYIN had a non-numeric amount on record 10442. With business approval moved record to PRD.HR.PAYIN.REJECT, restarted PAYR010 from STEP03 in Control-M (L2 approved). Ended OK, downstream released.

short_description: Payroll batch data exception abend 0C7
description: Night payroll run abend code S0C7 data exception in PAYR010, HR feed suspected.
resolution_notes: Found spaces in amount field of HR input file. HR resent corrected PRD.HR.PAYIN. Restarted PAYR010 from failing step. OK.

short_description: BILL030 abend SB37 month end
description: Billing job BILL030 abended SB37 writing PRD.BILL.MONTHEND output dataset.
resolution_notes: IEC030I showed out of space on PRD.BILL.MONTHEND. Increased SPACE secondary allocation in JCL override member and restarted from failing step. Completed.

short_description: BILL045 S806 module not found
description: BILL045 abended S806, load module BILCALC not found.
resolution_notes: Load module missing from PRD.LOADLIB after release; promotion missed. Escalated to application team who promoted BILCALC. Restarted job.

short_description: CICSPRD1 not responding, customer service screens hung
description: Customer service agents cannot use screens, CICSPRD1 issuing DFHSM0131 short on storage.
resolution_notes: CEMT I TASK showed looping transaction CS07. Purged task with CEMT SET TASK PURGE (L2 approved). SOS cleared without recycle. Problem ticket raised for CS07 loop.

short_description: PAYR020 SQLCODE -911 deadlock with online payroll
description: PAYR020 failed SQLCODE -911 reason 00C90088 deadlock; online PY01 users active.
resolution_notes: DSNT375I showed deadlock with PY01 transactions. Disabled PY01 via CEMT SET TRANSACTION DISABLED, restarted PAYR020 from failing step, re-enabled PY01 after completion.

short_description: Billing suite LATE alert, BILL010 waiting
description: Control-M LATE alert for billing suite; BILL010 in wait condition.
resolution_notes: Why option showed wait on PRD.ORA.EXTRACT. Oracle extract finished late because of backup overrun; file transferred at 03:10 and job started. No action on mainframe.

short_description: VSAM status 93 on customer master
description: Batch job got VSAM file status 93 opening PRD.CUST.MASTER.
resolution_notes: File was open in CICSPRD1. Closed file in CICS with CEMT SET FILE CLOSED during batch window (L2), batch completed, reopened file.

short_description: Invoices not printing, spool files RDY on PRT01
description: Warehouse cannot print invoices; spool files remain RDY on output queue PRT01, writer ended.
resolution_notes: QSYSOPR had CPA3394 on PRT01 (printer offline). Printer back online after paper jam cleared. Restarted writer with STRRMTWTR OUTQ(PRT01). Spool drained.

short_description: Writer PRT01 ended, output queue not draining
description: Output queue PRT01 has 300 spool files in RDY, writer not started.
resolution_notes: Pinged 10.20.4.51 OK. Started writer STRRMTWTR OUTQ(PRT01). Files moved to WTR and printed.

short_description: Nightly order import did not run, jobs stuck in WHSJOBQ
description: Order import jobs sitting in JOBQ status after weekend IPL.
resolution_notes: WRKSBS showed WHSBATCH not active after IPL. Started it with STRSBS SBSD(WHSLIB/WHSBATCH). Jobs ran. Raised problem to add WHSBATCH to startup program.

short_description: WHSJOBQ held, batch jobs not starting
description: Batch jobs not starting; WRKJOBQ shows WHSJOBQ status HLD.
resolution_notes: Queue held by operator during maintenance and not released. Released with RLSJOBQ JOBQ(WHSLIB/WHSJOBQ).

short_description: User cannot sign on, CPF1394 profile disabled
description: Warehouse supervisor cannot sign on to WHSPRD, message CPF1394.
resolution_notes: Verified approved access request. Re-enabled profile with CHGUSRPRF STATUS(*ENABLED), user reset password via self-service.

short_description: Invoice program INV100 crash MCH1210 receiver too small
description: INV100 ends with MCH1210 on very large invoice totals.
resolution_notes: Known issue fixed in WHSLIB v4.2. L3 applied v4.2 under change CHG0045512. Invoice reprocessed.

short_description: checkout-service pods OOMKilled, Java heap space
description: checkout-service pods restarting repeatedly; logs show java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space. Checkout errors for customers.
resolution_notes: Heap histogram showed CartCacheEntry dominating. Performed rolling restart kubectl rollout restart deployment/checkout-service (standard change). Config map was missing cart.cache.maxEntries; L3 added 50000 under change. Stable for 24h.

short_description: OutOfMemoryError in checkout after promo launch
description: Heap exhaustion in checkout-service during promo traffic, OOM errors.
resolution_notes: Rolling restart of checkout-service restored service. Heap histogram captured, cart cache growth confirmed.

short_description: order-api returning 504 gateway timeout
description: Mobile app order history failing, order-api returns HTTP 504; logs show SocketTimeoutException Read timed out calling pricing-service.
resolution_notes: pricing-service p99 at 6 s due to traffic spike. Scaled pricing-service to 6 replicas (pre-approved standard change). order-api p99 back to 400 ms.

short_description: order-api HikariPool connection not available, timeouts
description: order-api 504s; logs HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms.
resolution_notes: Hikari pending high. Oracle team found blocking session on ORDERS (ORA-RB-001) and killed idle blocker. order-api recovered.

short_description: Argo CD sync failed for order-api release 3.14
description: order-api Degraded after release, pods failing readiness probe.
resolution_notes: Readiness failing due to missing env var in new release. Rolled back with argocd app rollback shop-order-api to previous revision (release manager approved). Release team fixed manifest.

short_description: pricing-service ImagePullBackOff after deploy
description: New pricing-service pods stuck ImagePullBackOff.
resolution_notes: Image tag 2.8.1 not present in registry (typo 2.8.l). Release team corrected manifest; sync succeeded.

short_description: Long GC pauses on order-api at peak
description: G1 Evacuation Pause above 2 seconds on order-api during lunch peak, latency spikes.
resolution_notes: No confirmed fix. Collected GC logs and passed to L3 for tuning analysis.

short_description: NullPointerException in order-api when promo code empty
description: order-api throws java.lang.NullPointerException in PromoService.apply when promo code field is empty.
resolution_notes: Code defect. Hotfix 3.13.2 deployed by development team under change. Verified orders without promo code succeed.

short_description: Suspicious logins on order-api service account
description: Security incident, handled by SecOps.
resolution_notes: Restricted.
